text: All-on-4 replaces a whole arch, so it suits people losing most or all of the teeth in one jaw, or living with a denture they want gone. Bone loss is often the reason it is chosen rather than a reason against it.
Most teeth in one jaw missing, failing or loose
A denture that slips, rubs or needs adhesive
Bone loss at the back of the jaw, which the angled implants avoid
Teeth that cannot be saved: where the case allows, they come out the day the implants go in
For three to four months you wear a fixed provisional arch in PMMA while the implants fuse. It looks and works like teeth, but it is a stage, not the result.
Soft foods while the implants integrate
Reviews along the way to check integration
Adjustments to the provisional as the gum settles
Back to normal activity within about a week
Minor discomfort, handled with over-the-counter medication
Then the zirconia arch is fitted, and two to four more months finish the healing around it. From that point it is brushed and flossed like natural teeth, with a cleaning every six months.
